answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 144 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lantern. The raven index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the mirror queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. Slashing removes 38 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
